# Colour roles

Source: `tokens.json` (`color.light`, `color.dark`). A colour is always used by its **name** (CSS variable `--color-<name>`), never by hex. The canvases are drawn with these variables only; `scripts/check.cjs` fails when a frame uses a colour that is not listed here.

## Identity

| Role | Token | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary | `brand-500` | `#0b4f94` | `#2b7fc9` |
| Navy | `brand-600` | `#083a6e` | `#5aaef0` |
| Sky | `brand-400` | `#3caae5` | `#3caae5` |
| Ink | `ink` | `#17324d` | `#e6eef6` |
| Ink soft (muted) | `ink-soft` | `#5a6d80` | `#9db0c3` |
| Canvas (paper) | `canvas` | `#f4f8fb` | `#0a1624` |
| Surface | `surface` | `#ffffff` | `#112236` |
| Line | `line` | `#d9e5ee` | `#1f3550` |
| Tile | `tile` | `#eaf1f7` | `#18304a` |
| Success | `success` | `#28745d` | `#7fd3b4` |
| Info | `info` | `#426c8a` | `#9cc4e0` |
| Warning | `warning` | `#8a6727` | `#e6c27a` |
| Danger | `danger` | `#a13f46` | `#f0a3a8` |

Hierarchy: light canvas, white surface, ink text, one prominent action. Sky is decoration; status colours always come with a word.

## Accent

| Token | CSS variable | Light | Dark | Role | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accent` | `--color-accent` | `#c56d5c` | `#d98a7a` | Coral | Decoration only |
| `accent-strong` | `--color-accent-strong` | `#a8503f` | `#b5594a` | Coral strong | Sidebar count badge background (white text 5.4:1) |

Status colours come in triples: `<tone>` is text and icon, `<tone>-soft` the background, `<tone>-line` the border. Tones: success, info, warning, danger.
